title: Microwindow Accordion Calendar and Release Journal — Oct 2027 (Draft)
content:
Purpose:
This doc captures the microwindow 'accordion' rollout plan for the release on 2027-10-22, the associated calendar of gated traffic shifts, and a living draft of release notes. The goal is to stage small-capacity, low-risk changes that can expand (accordion) if signals remain green, and contract rapidly on degradation.

Quick context / background:
- Target: platform v3.18.2 with batching changes and KV cache tweak (PR #6223).
- Primary risk vector: increased tail latency under specific long-sequence workloads.
- Rollout style: microwindow (small % -> expand by doubling windows), 6-stage accordion over 48h.

Owner / Responders:
- Release lead: Priya Nandakumar (primary contact)
- On-call SRE: Ethan Zhou
- Experiments / Metrics: Lina Morales
- Rollback owner: Samir Patel

Preflight checklist (48h before):
- [ ] Finalize canary config in infra (k8s manifests) and pin runtime flags (RELENG-4589).
- [ ] Smoke test on staging with long-seq replay (target P95 < 220ms).
- [ ] Agree on telemetry buckets and alerts (see thresholds below).
- [ ] Prepare rollback image and rollback runbook URL in the watch channel.
- [ ] Notify customer-success teams for enterprise customers with scheduled quiet windows.

Accordion rollout calendar (UTC):
Day 0 - 2027-10-22 09:00 - Launch window 1 (microwindow):
  - Start: 09:00, traffic = 0.1% global (control plane route tag: accordion-stage-1)
  - Duration: 2 hours (collect warmup + steady signals)
  - Acceptance: P50 latency regression < +10ms, P95 < +50ms, error rate delta < 0.02%
  - If green -> expand to stage 2; if amber -> hold and investigate; if red -> immediate backout to previous model image

Day 0 - 2027-10-22 13:00 - Stage 2 (expand)
  - traffic = 0.5% for 3 hours
  - run sample-heavy replay on shadow traffic (Lina)

Day 1 - 2027-10-23 02:00 - Stage 3
  - traffic = 2% for 4 hours (monitor saturation signals on GPU pools)

Day 1 - 2027-10-23 14:00 - Stage 4
  - traffic = 10% for 6 hours (start cost telemetry and throttling watch)

Day 2 - 2027-10-24 08:00 - Stage 5
  - traffic = 30% for 12 hours (run A/B quality checks, sampling prompts)

Day 2 - 2027-10-24 22:00 - Stage 6 (full)
  - traffic = 100% ramp if all signals green, otherwise staged hold at 50% and manual review

Signals and thresholds (primary):
- Latency P50 / P95 / P99 (compare to baseline window)
- Error rate: 5XX / model-timeouts / transport errors (alert on > 3x baseline or absolute > 0.1%)
- GPU queue length and utilization: sustained > 85% for 10min -> amber
- Cost delta per token: > +25% -> investigate quantization knob and batching config
- Quality regression: automated eval score drop > 2% on key prompt set -> immediate hold

Escalation path (quick):
1) On-call SRE gets page -> initial triage (first 15min)
2) If confirmed degradation -> release lead evaluates per-stage rollback (15–45min)
3) Exec notify and CS notify for customer-impacting issues (>30min unresolved)

Rollback procedures:
- Soft rollback: reduce traffic back to prior stage for 30–60min while retaining logs and traces.
- Hard rollback: redeploy previous image and revert runtime flags (prebuilt rollback image is tagged v3.18.1-rollback).
- Post-rollback: run forensics checklist, snapshot heap/metrics, capture traces, open postmortem ticket if >30min downtime or customer impact.

Nightwatch tasks (for overnight stages):
- Rotate a smaller night ops pair (Ethan + Lina) 00:00–08:00 UTC.
- Maintain 15min heartbeat posts to #release-ops.
- Run scheduled query to sample 1k generation outputs for quality spot-checks.

Release notes draft (to be cleaned for public):
- Platform: v3.18.2
- Highlights: Improved batching heuristics and KV-prefix caching that reduces cold-start token cost.
- Known issues: Under long-sequence (>1024 tokens) tails, a small subset of requests may see elevated P99 latency during warmup (will be monitored and patched).
- Rollout plan: Gradual microwindow accordion over 48h; immediate rollback thresholds configured.

Open items / TODOs:
- [ ] Finish automated quality evaluation deck and attach to PR (Lina)
- [ ] Confirm dedicated canary pool capacity with infra (Samir)
- [ ] Draft customer-facing blurb for enterprise customers (Priya)
- [ ] Add runbook snippet to Confluence with exact kubectl commands and escalation numbers

Notes to self:
- Keep expansion conservative; prefer slower steady gains over rapid doubling if any amber appears.
- Watch for correlated increases in downstream retrials (proxy-level) — sometimes proxy backpressure masks model regressions.
- If a partial region shows trouble but global is green, pivot to region-based throttles rather than full rollback.

Appendix: useful command snippets and links
- kubectl rollout status deployment/platform-inference-canary -n production
- curl -H 'x-release-stage: accordion-stage-2' https://api.redwood.ai/healthcheck
- Query for telemetry: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abcd/accordion-signals

End of draft.
Please add notes inline and tag owners for each checklist line.
